name: framed_deposit_region

phase_0.boundary_condition: The frame pair closes the system: every deposit enters a frame opened before it, every frame closes after the reversal it protects, and the outer fuse restores exactly what the clear took. The IFIX record seals the closure.

VINIT.justification: the void state before any token runs, four constituents unset

TANCH.justification: the terminal boundary that contains the whole sequence, the closed vessel of the discipline

AFWD.justification: the forward morphism that carries a deposit toward its banked depth

AREV.justification: the contravariant move that empties the register's open half while banked weight survives

CLINK.justification: sequential composition, the lemma stays in scope while the later chain runs

IMSCRIB.justification: identity, the register holds its own weight through the reversal it survives

FSPLIT.justification: one state opens into a banked half and an exposed half, the weight sits one level up

FFUSE.justification: the arms rejoin, what was banked returns to the register, reconstituting the split input

EVALT.justification: touches the T constituent and banks one unit at the current depth

EVALF.justification: touches the F constituent, the negative arm present in the register but not exercised by this discipline

ENGAGR.justification: both T and F held at once without resolution, the dialetheic register state

IFIX.justification: permanent fixation, the closure verdict is appended and cannot be undone

phase_2.split_input: the register with the T constituent banked one level up inside the open frame
split_outputs: the banked half held at depth one
the open half exposed to the register
phase_2.fuse_result: the register with the T constituent banked one level up inside the open frame
phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: the uninitialized register, four constituents unset, before any weight exists
phase_3.true_description: the register holding the T constituent, one unit of weight banked at depth one
phase_3.false_description: the register holding the F constituent, the refuted arm standing alone
phase_3.both_description: the register holding T and F simultaneously, the dialetheic state kept live without resolution

steps.domain_action: the empty register opens, four constituents unset, the void before any weight exists
the outer frame opens, the region that will hold the result once banked
the inner frame opens inside it, the region that computes the deposit
the deposit lands inside the inner frame, touching the T constituent and banking one unit at depth two
the inner frame closes, folding the deposit into the enclosing frame at depth one
the continuation chains, the lemma stays in scope while the reversal runs
the clearing reversal fires, emptying the register's open half while the frame holds the weight
the conclusion deposit lands in the open register, re-establishing the T constituent after the clear
the outer frame closes, restoring exactly what the clear took, the banked weight returns to the register
the closure fixes, the record seals, the verdict becomes permanent

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the word writer that turns the discipline into a token sequence
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: the frame handoff, the inner fuse folds its result into the enclosing frame
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the register, four constituents whose deposits accumulate
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: token order, one opcode per step, the reversal placed between the two fuses
phase_5.alfs_store: the banked-weight lemma in p4ramill Imscribing IMASM BankedWeight.lean

phase_6.cycle_cost: one clear per reversal, the weight it takes is exactly what the fuse restores
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: the register holding the deposit inside the open frame
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the register holding the deposit after the outer fuse
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the clear takes one unit and the fuse restores one unit, the cycle conserves weight
